page_title: UDI 2-2 TOR | Udinese v Torino 29/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' A player from Torino pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
90+3' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
90+2' A pass by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Today's match ends for Yann Karamoh who will be replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
90' Ivan Ilic (Torino) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
87' James Abankwah (Udinese) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Francesco Fourneau ignores the protests.
86' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
83' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Borna Sosa is replaced by Ali Dembele (Torino).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nikola Vlasic departs the field of play to be replaced by Karol Linetty (Torino).
81' Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game. One of the players from Udinese won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
80' It will be a substitution. Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Florian Thauvin walks off.
76' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
72' Here comes a substitution. Sandi Lovric is given a rest as he is replaced by James Abankwah (Udinese).
72' Substitution. Isaak Toure makes his way off the pitch and Arthur Atta (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
71' Przemyslaw Malecki has decided to substitute Jordan Zemura and he is replaced by Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
70' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a comfortable save.
69' High and wide! Saul Coco (Torino) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
66' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) brings an opponent down and Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game.
66' Yann Karamoh (Torino) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
64' 2 - 2 Goal! Che Adams provides Samuele Ricci (Torino) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 2:2.
64' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
61' Borna Sosa (Torino) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
60' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) launches a cross from the corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert to thwart the effort.
59' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
58' Now Udinese have a corner.
57' Samuele Ricci (Torino) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
56' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Udinese was in an offside position.
53' 2 - 1 Goal 2:1! Che Adams (Torino) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
53' Che Adams (Torino) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Razvan Sava. What a save!
53' It will be a corner kick for Torino.
52' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
49' 2 - 0 Florian Thauvin takes over corner duties and expertly finds Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the back of the net. The score is now 2:0.
49' There's an opportunity for Florian Thauvin (Udinese) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
49' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
46' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Gvidas Gineitis will be replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
46' Half-time substitution. Paolo Vanoli decided to make a change. Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is replaced by Valentino Lazaro.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Udinese are ruled offside.
45+2' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+2' Samuele Ricci (Torino) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Razvan Sava!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' A quickly taken corner by Torino.

44' Che Adams (Torino) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Torino win a corner kick.
41' 1 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Isaak Toure (Udinese) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:0.
41' Corner kick. Udinese will have an opportunity.
40' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
38' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Yann Karamoh (Torino) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
36' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
35' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
33' Borna Sosa (Torino) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Razvan Sava, who smothers the ball.
30' A player from Torino commits a rough challenge. Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
28' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
27' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
26' A player from Torino brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Udinese win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
25' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
23' The game is interrupted now, Nikola Vlasic (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' A player from Udinese commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
21' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francesco Fourneau no option but to blow his whistle.
19' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
17' Yann Karamoh (Torino) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
16' The ball has crossed the sideline. Torino are taking a throw-in.
13' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic punches the ball away.

11' That didn't go as planned! Yann Karamoh (Torino) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Razvan Sava, who easily kept it out.
11' A cross from Sandi Lovric (Udinese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
9' Nice passing game by Udinese. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
6' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
4' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
2' Yann Karamoh (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Razvan Sava intercepts the ball.
2' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) meets a cross inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
